production.notes: Cloudflare API token is not stored here. Provide it through CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or a secrets broker.

credentials.name: scythe-cloudflare-access-admin
credentials.purpose: Deploy the Scythe Worker, attach the scythe.work custom domain, and manage Access identity providers and application/policies.
scopes: Account:Access Organizations, Identity Providers, and Groups Write
credentials.rotation: manual until a secrets broker is selected

credentials.name: scythe-agent-verify
credentials.purpose: Let Codex verify the protected Scythe site without browser OTP or mailbox access.

cloudflare.notes: Cloudflare owns hosting, custom domain routing, DNS, and Access for scythe.work. One scoped token should be enough for routine agent operation after the zone is active.

vercel.notes: Deprecated for Scythe. Do not deploy new production state here.

otpPolicy.notes: Do not give Codex broad inbox access. Cloudflare Access should use Cloudflare account login or another IdP rather than agent-read email OTP.
